The '''Grand Duchy of Solan''' was one of the predecessor states that formed [[Solara]] in early 1538.

== Role In Unification ==

Old source material identifies Solan as part of the coalition that fought alongside the [[Kingdom of Congrave]] against the [[Kingdom of Albion]] during the [[Solaran War of Unification]].

The source does not say whether Solan was the larger partner, what its capital was, who ruled it, or how its institutions were merged into the new Solaran state. This draft therefore preserves only its source-attested role as a predecessor state and coalition member.

== Legacy ==

Solan's absorption into Solara helped give the new parliamentary state legitimacy beyond Congrave alone. Its name remained attached to the Solaran formation tradition and to the old predecessor-state flag material preserved in the Miraheze dump.
